verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a programmatic HTTP API and SDK reference that can drive the product without its UI. Examples include listing posts, managing AI training data pushed 'from your systems', and find/replace article edits pitched for AI agents. That makes API-driven headless automation plausible, but there is no CLI, CI integration, or documented pipeline usage. missing for 10: official CLI or CI action/integration, documented headless/CI workflow guides, auth guidance for non-interactive tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
